calculation_handling.description: In the R zone, an ancillary building containing a parking space (detached garage) must be at least 1.0 m from a rear or side lot line that abuts a street or lane, subject to 10.5.60.20(4).
calculation_handling.gaps: Target chosen as lot_line_setback_m (ancillary building setback) because the minimum applies to either a rear or a side lot line; the "abutting a street or lane" test is a disjunction (street or lane), so it is not keyed as a conjunctive condition token. Subject to 10.5.60.20(4) (not expressed).

calculation_handling.description: No minimum setback is required for such a garage from a rear or side lot line that does not abut a street or lane.
calculation_handling.gaps: "no minimum building setback is required" keyed as unregulated (the by-law sets no limit). The "does not abut a street or lane" test is not keyed as a condition token (no negated street/lane token).

10.10.60.20(1).explanation: In the R zone, a detached garage (an ancillary building with a parking space) must be at least 1.0 m from a rear or side lot line next to a street or lane, and needs no setback from a rear or side lot line that does not border a street or lane.
